issues.title: unsupported claim
issues.text: Toss it in your bag without worrying about spills.
issues.reason: The copy implies leakproof or spill-proof performance ('without worrying about spills'). The allowed facts only confirm a 'Screw-top lid', which does not objectively guarantee containment performance. Without explicit authorization for leak resistance, this is an unsupported claim.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the implication of spill-proofing. For example: 'Features a screw-top lid.' or 'Suitable for daily use.'
